info.title: GameON API
info.description: GameON REST API. Use Bearer access tokens for protected routes. Cookie-changing auth requests require X-GameON-CSRF: 1. Access tokens last 15 minutes; refresh sessions last up to 30 days. Documentation snapshot with illustrative request and response examples. IDs and tokens are examples, not live credentials. No ordering or pricing endpoints.
